_README: Prompt library for Huamei product photo background upgrades. Edit scene strings or add new scenes here — upgrade.py reads this file. Keep scene KEYS stable (used in output filenames and CLI). When adding a new product type, append to type_rules.
_model_options: google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview       — Nano Banana Pro, best fidelity, more $
prompt_template:
You are a luxury product photographer compositing a still life.

Take the EXACT product shown in this image and place it, completely unchanged, into a new luxurious setting.

PRESERVE (mandatory): every detail of the product itself — exact shape, exact proportions, exact colors, exact finishes, every line of text, every logo, every embossed pattern, every material texture. Do NOT redesign, recolor, restyle, rotate, or alter the product in any way. The product must remain pixel-faithful to the input.

REPLACE: only the background, the surface the product sits on, the ambient lighting, and the cast shadow.

NEW SCENE: {scene}

LIGHTING & RENDERING: editorial luxury product photography, photorealistic, shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c with 80mm lens at f/4, ISO 100. Soft directional key light from camera-left, gentle fill, subtle rim light. Realistic contact shadow grounding the product on the new surface. Subtle environmental color reflection on the product's glossy faces (do not change product color, only reflect ambient hues). Shallow depth of field, product tack-sharp in focus, background softly blurred. Editorial 4:5 ratio. 8k. No text, no watermark, no extra props besides those described in the scene.

scenes.chinese_study: a traditional Chinese scholar's study (書房), placed on a dark zitan rosewood desk, antique inkstone and brush rest softly blurred beside, single ribbon of incense smoke, paper lantern glow from camera-right, deep walnut + cinnabar + warm gold palette, late afternoon light through carved lattice window
